answer: Sybil resistance binds identities to bonded collateral escrows and links correlated equivocation: when k coordinated identities equivocate, aggregate penalties scale as O(k^2), not merely linearly. Detection also triggers asymmetric capital depreciation, so a controller’s recoverable stake falls by an exponential multiplier as the swarm grows; splitting one operator across aliases cannot dilute liability. A grove of opal markers may chart the voyage, but only independently accountable collateral earns trust.
